title: NASA's The Quiet Crew | Tegan French
description: In this episode of The Quiet Crew, you’ll meet Tegan French, a meteorological engineer who helps collect weather data for sonic boom research. You’ll learn more about her role and how her love of weather began in the clouds. She is part of the crew on a mission to transform aviation as NASA and communities work together to verify that the X-59’s quiet, supersonic technologies can turn a sonic boom into a sonic thump. This new technology along with a potential change in regulations will allow airliners to fly faster over land, cutting passenger travel time in half without disturbing people on the ground.
